name: sijav-codex
description: Eight Sijav skills for Codex: rules, dev-round, native agents, search, research, roast, to-do board and an owner-started project loop. Native Codex agents do noncoding work; Claude Opus 5.5 alone codes and reviews code through a session helper. Jev judges code-free roast questions and research citations; the to-do skill includes a read-only board dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Sijav skills: native agents, Claude coding, Jev roasts, research, board and loop.
interface.longDescription: Eight skills are discovered from the root skills/ directory; rules, dev-round and loop run only when invoked explicitly. Codex orchestrates and native agents do noncoding work. Claude Opus 5.5 is called through skills/claude/claude_session.py for code and technical review only. skills/roast/jev.py and skills/research/verify.py ask Jev code-free questions and check cited quotes on their pages. The to-do skill's dashboard is a read-only local view of a project's existing board. Installing starts nothing. The loop's Stop hook re-feeds the project's law to the one Codex session that started it, up to an explicit iteration cap, until the exact completion promise ends a final message; its SessionStart compact hook reloads the law after compaction for that session only.
